plainTranslation: The Saturn person and Sun person can polarize around freedom and responsibility. One carries the brakes, one carries the life force, and both may resent the role they are handed. Make the expectations explicit so the bond does not turn into parent and child.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
